era: London 1850 (all story frames); salon 1850 (cold open); present day 2020s (T01-T04)

characters.hero: bald stickman clerk, 20: dark brown frock coat, cream waistcoat, white shirt, black neck-tie, black shoes; at night a long off-white nightshirt. Gets thinner each stage: Month 1 normal, Month 6 pink cheek spots, Year 1 thinner + shining eyes, Year 2 grey face, hollow cheeks, coat hanging loose
characters.doctor: stickman doctor 1850: black frock coat, black top hat, white high collar, small black bag
characters.landlady: stickman woman: grey dress, white apron, white cap covering the head
characters.boy: landlady's small son: stickman boy, brown jacket, short trousers, flat cap
characters.clerks: office clerks: stickmen in dark frock coats at tall desks
characters.guests: 1850 salon guests: pale thin stickmen; gentlemen bald in tailcoats; LADIES in crinolines WITH 1850 hair (dark, middle parting, low bun, side ringlets)
characters.byron: Lord Byron as a stickman: open white shirt collar, dark velvet jacket, black cape
characters.lady: White Lady (tuberculosis) as on sheet 1de80806 and in old ep07: life-size adult, ghostly gaunt emaciated Victorian woman, waxy grey-white skin, hollow cheeks with red feverish blotches, sunken dark-ringed eyes, pale bluish lips, long unkempt dark hair, tattered white high-collared nightgown, grey knitted shawl; one prop at a time; ironic, not cute, never doll-sized
characters.modern: 2020s: hero in a dark grey hoodie and jeans; doctor/nurse in blue scrubs and scrub cap
characters.extras: London street crowd 1850: stickmen in period coats, top hats, bonnets

locations.salon: 1850 drawing room: tall curtained window, fireplace with gilt mirror, velvet sofa
locations.room: hero's rented room: iron bed with grey blanket left, small window with London chimneys back, washstand with jug and basin, wooden chair with coat
locations.mirror: close shot at the washstand: one tall oval mirror, jug and basin; ONLY ONE mirror
locations.atlas: 1850s anatomy atlas page: same lungs engraving; disease always in the hero's RIGHT lung first (viewer's left), then both
locations.office: 1850 counting house: tall wooden desks in a row, high windows, gas-less (candles/daylight)
locations.street: foggy London street 1850: brick houses, horse cabs
locations.modern_street: 2020s city street at dusk (glass buildings, parked cars)

1850: bare skin-coloured arms (stickmen have black stick arms)
